create_ase_read_dataset: create an AseReadDataset to load ASE-readable files from a directory using a glob pattern
create_ase_read_multi_dataset: create an AseReadMultiStructureDataset to read multiple structures from trajectory or XYZ files
create_ase_db_dataset: create an AseDBDataset to connect to one or more ASE database files for molecular data
apply_one_tags_function: apply default tags of 1 to an ASE Atoms object for models that require tagged atoms
connect_ase_db: connect to an ASE database at a given path using AseDBDataset.connect_db with optional arguments
